summary: Removes the hardcoded '../' prefix that assumed SVG-embedded diagram links resolve one level deep, aligning inheritance-diagram URLs with document-relative resolution so nested pages no longer 404. Change is minimal and symmetric across the refuri/refid branches; matches the known upstream fix.

issues.description: After removing '../', the refuri branch's `if graphviz_output_format == 'SVG'` / `else` now assigns identical values (`child.get('refuri')`) in both arms — the conditional is dead and could be collapsed to a single assignment. Harmless, kept parallel to the refid branch; not blocking.

Correctness depends on SVG links being resolved relative to the embedding HTML document (as PNG imagemaps are) rather than the shared _images/ SVG location. Assuming the graphviz SVG-embedding side already provides that (repro + regression tests pass), the fix is complete; if it did not, root-level diagrams would regress — worth a maintainer confirming the companion behavior, but not a diff-visible defect.
